一个人、一台电脑、一套AI工具，便能创作出一部完整作品，技术显著降低了创作门槛，: With one person, one computer, and one set of AI tools, one can create a complete work; technology has significantly lowered the threshold for creation and greatly stimulated the creative enthusiasm of diverse subjects.
有人将《映山红》翻译成朝鲜语版并由AI歌手演唱，这首表达赣南苏区百姓盼望红军归来: Someone translated 'Azalea' into Korean and had an AI singer perform it; this old song expressing the hopes of the people of Gannan Soviet District for the Red Army's return took on new form, crossing mountains and seas to reach new audiences.
如此改编经典怎么看（锐见）: What to make of such adaptations of classics (Sharp observations)
创作者借助AI工具，以86版电视剧《西游记》和87版电视剧《红楼梦》的主角形象和: Creators using AI tools, based on the protagonist images and footage from the 1986 TV series 'Journey to the West' and the 1987 TV series 'Dream of the Red Chamber,' have conducted bold new adaptations, bringing together Sun Wukong and Lin Daiyu.
而今，借助视频这种直观生动的形式，AI又降低了制作门槛，二创才一次次掀起刷屏传播: Today, with the help of video as a direct and vivid medium, AI has further lowered production thresholds, and derivative creations have sparked trending spreads again and again.
不论是之前的“雪山救狐狸”，还是这一次的“圣黛CP”，都体现了AI赋能之下经典影: Whether the earlier 'rescuing a fox on snowy mountains' or this 'Shengdai CP,' both reflect the boom in adapting classic film and television works under AI empowerment.

扶持真人剧，扶持精品创作（艺海观澜）: Supporting live-action dramas, supporting quality productions (Observations on the arts)
在人工智能给视听艺术带来剧烈变化的时刻，扶持真人剧切中了人们心中的困惑与焦虑，也: At a time when artificial intelligence is bringing dramatic changes to audiovisual arts, support for live-action dramas strikes at the heart of people's confusion and anxiety, and also reflects audiences' expectations for good content and quality works.
AI剧的供给主要集中在微短剧领域，月产数万部，占比超九成，规模可观，但多数是观众: The supply of AI dramas is mainly concentrated in the micro-drama sector, producing tens of thousands monthly and accounting for over 90 percent of the total, with considerable scale, but most are quick-consumption products that audiences forget immediately after viewing, and works with both acclaim and influence remain limited.
无论是已经量产的AI微短剧，还是刚刚出现的AI长剧、AI网络故事片，相比真人实拍: Whether already mass-produced AI micro-dramas or newly emerging AI full-length dramas and AI web films, compared with real-person filming they still have gaps; the 'AI flavor' in aspects such as character expressions, body movements, and scene lighting and shadow makes it difficult for audiences to truly immerse themselves in the story.
就在AI剧产能井喷，品质却难孚众望之时，《太平年》《主角》等精品剧集接连面世，这: Just as AI drama production capacity explodes while quality falls short of expectations, quality dramas such as 'The Peaceful Years' and 'The Protagonist' have come out in succession; these major dramas are carefully crafted following traditional production paradigms, transforming genuine insights into history, the times, and life and profound reflections into solid scripts and vivid characters, 'hand-crafting' piece by piece the weight that quality works should possess.
真人剧带给观众的笑与泪是如此真实，带给观众的心灵触动是如此持久，AI剧目前替代不: The laughter and tears that live-action dramas bring to audiences are so authentic, the emotional resonance they bring is so enduring—AI dramas cannot currently replace this.
与AI剧迅猛生长相伴而生的，还有真人创作者权益保护的全新课题: Accompanying the rapid growth of AI dramas is a new issue: the protection of rights and interests of real-person creators.
AI大模型海量训练所使用的语料中，也不乏真人剧作品，相关权益如何认定，尚无清晰规: The massive training corpora of large AI models include no shortage of real-person drama works, and how to identify relevant rights remains without clear rules.
有研究者提出担忧，若AI生成内容持续爆发，且后续大模型以AI次生内容迭代训练，全: Some researchers have raised concerns that if AI-generated content continues to explode, and subsequent large models iterate training with AI secondary content, the risk of homogenization and flattening of the entire network content pool may intensify.
相关规范引导工作已经起步：广电总局近期已就AI微短剧“融像”“融声”召开座谈会，: Relevant normative guidance work has already begun: The National Radio and Television Administration recently held symposiums on AI micro-dramas' 'image fusion' and 'audio fusion,' reaching consensus that 'image fusion' and 'audio fusion' must obtain explicit authorization from rights holders.
国家版权局等四部门“剑网2026”专项行动也专门提出，推动解决大模型训练语料版权: The 'Sword Network 2026' special action by the National Copyright Administration and three other departments also specifically proposes to promote solutions to the copyright compliance issues of large model training corpora.
视听艺术本就因技术而生、因技术而兴，AI作为新一轮科技革命和产业变革的引领性、战: Audiovisual arts have been created by technology and have flourished because of technology; AI, as a leading and strategic technology of a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, has opened up entirely new possibilities for audiovisual arts.
数据显示，利用AI独立完成1分钟以上故事成片的创作者已有18万人，一批审美在线、: Data shows that creators who can independently complete story production of one minute or more using AI have reached 180,000, and a batch of 'AI super creators' with refined aesthetics and a passion for expression are beginning to emerge.
再如，AI为高成本、高难度场面降本增效提供助力: Furthermore, AI provides leverage for reducing costs and increasing efficiency for high-cost, high-difficulty scenes.
《太平年》中令人印象深刻的暴风雨海战场景，借助AI生成海浪流体，以往需两个月完成: The impressive stormy sea battle scene in Peaceful Years leverages AI to generate ocean wave fluids, compressing shots that previously took two months to complete into just two weeks.
借助AI，《后西游记》可以高频呈现神话场景与打斗场面，天马行空的想象和酣畅淋漓的: With the aid of AI, After Journey to the West can frequently present mythological scenes and fight sequences, and flights of imagination and exhilarating action scenes are no longer constrained by budget.
有了AI这个对照，创作者更应认真检视自身、鞭策自我——是否真正将独属真人的专业能: With AI as a reference point, creators should examine themselves more earnestly and spur themselves forward—whether they truly integrate professional capabilities and life experiences unique to real actors into their work, and whether they can establish emotional communication with audiences that technology cannot replace.
不管是真人剧还是AI剧，都是为真人而创作，为满足观众精神文化需求而创作，为增加人: Whether it is live-action dramas or AI dramas, both are created for real people, created to meet audiences' spiritual and cultural needs, and created to enhance people's cultural fulfillment and sense of happiness.
重要的是各方面协同发力，充分释放AI正向价值，让这个“新的变量”成为“新的增量”: What matters is coordinated efforts from all sides, fully unleashing the positive value of AI, and turning this 'new variable' into a 'new increment.'
